title: Brazen words after wrongdoing
meaning_odia: ଏଠାରେ ମୁହଁ ଟାଣର ଅର୍ଥ ହେଲା କଟୁ ବା ଅନୁଚିତ କଥା କହିବାରେ ସଂକୋଚ ନଥିବା। ଆମ ପଢ଼ାରେ, ଭୁଲ କରି ମଧ୍ୟ ଲଜ୍ଜା ନକରି ଉଦ୍ଧତ କଥା କହିବାକୁ ଉକ୍ତିଟି ଭର୍ତ୍ସନା କରୁଛି। କେବଳ କାହାର କଥା କହିବା ଢଙ୍ଗ ଦେଖି ସେ ଚୋର ବୋଲି ପ୍ରମାଣ ହୁଏ ନାହିଁ।
explanation: The tough mouth is an idiom for unrestrained, impudent speech. Our reading hears a rebuke aimed at someone who responds brazenly despite wrongdoing. The force comes from the mismatch between what calls for accountability and the speaker’s unapologetic manner.
usage_example: Original imagined example: Someone admits taking another person’s belongings without permission, then answers the complaint with insults. A bystander quotes the saying about that brazen response.
cultural_context: The mouth stands for speech, and its hardness gives the speech a resistant, unyielding quality. ଭାରି intensifies the accusation in a compact conversational sentence.
